description: Requests a webhook URL received, oldest first: pass after_id for only newer ones, and wait_seconds to wait briefly for the next.

bin.description: Bin id from create_webhook_url (or its capture or private page URL)

key.description: Bin key from create_webhook_url (not needed with the private page URL)

name: list_webhook_requests
title: List requests received by a webhook URL
